theme: An open calendar, a stack of travel calls past their date.
greeting: The calendar's nearly empty today, Dan — only the call with Pema this afternoon. What's actually waiting is the travel planning that slipped past its September 30 deadline.

needsAttention.title: December break destinations
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist was due September 30 and the book-by is October 15 — holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. The call is domestic by default, or international on refundable bookings only since the passports land in November.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 and open since September 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out; a refundable PWM hold now costs nothing and takes the risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland to St Pete drive sits in the October 5–18 off-week gap, three days out. Book the one hotel night once the dates are set.

needsAttention.title: Term life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Three term quotes have been open since September 25. The shopping is yours to do, but it still needs a target coverage amount and term length before it can move.

schedule.title: Call from Pema
schedule.detail: One hour, the only thing booked today.

flagged.title: Apple sign-in notice
flagged.detail: An 'AppleCare One: Action required' mail to your konigsburg.com address says a new Apple Account signed in to an iPhone 17e. Worth checking straight from Settings rather than the link — the wording also fits a phishing pattern.

flagged.title: DIRA & DIBA meeting materials
flagged.detail: David Wetherbee sent the packet for the October 25 meeting. Questions go to him; nothing is owed today.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, retail promos, LinkedIn job alerts, and routine receipts.

recipe.title: Lamb Shanks with Crushed Roots
recipe.why: Slow-braised and root-forward, right for cool autumn evenings and the first real market roots.

tasks.title: Portland house order — king bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: A clear morning, nothing on the calendar.
One call with Pema at 2:30, otherwise unbooked.
